# Othership

> > Immersive wellness studio offering transformative sauna, ice bath, and breathwork experiences across multiple locations with a music-driven app for nervous system regulation.

Othership operates performance sauna and cold-water immersion studios in New York City, Brooklyn, and Toronto, complemented by a guided breathwork app. The platform combines physical wellness experiences with digital tools for stress relief, recovery, and nervous system regulation.

## Key Topics

- Breathwork
- Performance Sauna
- Ice Bath / Cold Plunge
- Nervous System Regulation
- Sauna-Ice Bath Experience
- Wellness Classes
- NYC Locations (Flatiron, Williamsburg)
- Toronto Locations (Adelaide, Yorkville)
- Othership App
- Health Benefits
- Membership & Pricing
- Corporate Partnerships
- Wellness Products
- Music-Driven Experiences
- Recovery & Mental Clarity

## Core Experiences

- [Experience | Othership](https://www.othership.us/experience): Overview of Othership's sauna, ice bath, and breathwork experiences
- [Traditional Hot Sauna | Othership](https://www.othership.us/traditional-hot-sauna): Performance sauna experience for stress relief and cardiovascular health
- [Custom Ice Bath | Othership](https://www.othership.us/custom-ice-bath-experience): Cold-water immersion experience for recovery and mental clarity
- [Othership App | Guided Breathwork](https://www.othership.us/app): Music-driven breathwork app for nervous system regulation and wellness

## Locations

- [Locations | Othership](https://www.othership.us/locations): Find Othership studios in Williamsburg, Flatiron, Adelaide, Yorkville
- [Flatiron | Othership](https://www.othership.us/flatiron): Othership Flatiron NYC location for sauna, ice bath, guided classes
- [Williamsburg | Othership](https://www.othership.us/williamsburg): Othership Williamsburg Brooklyn location launching with founding members
- [Adelaide | Othership](https://www.othership.us/adelaide): Othership Adelaide Toronto location with sauna, ice bath, breathwork
- [Yorkville | Othership](https://www.othership.us/yorkville): Othership Yorkville Toronto location with 90-person performance sauna
